blockers.description: BUS-117 — the backend unit baseline is NOT deterministic. Measured 71 AND 72 on byte-identical trees by TWO independent agents. CLAUDE.md pins the ceiling at `failed <= 71` with explicitly zero headroom, so a clean tree can fail the gate and a phase can be blamed for a flake it did not cause.
blockers.workaround: Unstable test is tests/unit/test_cross_worker_cancellation.py::test_a_late_producer_finalize_may_not_write_failed_over_a_cancel — passes 28/28 in isolation, fails only in the full suite via an unraisable 'coroutine handle_query_tables was never awaited' attributed at GC time. Fix the flake OR restate the ceiling as 72. CLAUDE.md forbids weakening it without operator authorisation.

blockers.description: BUS-114 — the IngestionStrip ordered fence has been RED since before Phase 229, so the vitest count gate CANNOT reach green for anyone. documents.py has 7 distinct ingestion_step writes; the fence asserts exactly 6.
blockers.workaround: Needs routing to a phase or a /gsd:fast. Root cause of the long miss: 'frontend untouched so the gate cannot be affected' is UNSOUND here — that suite imports backend/app/api/documents.py?raw.

blockers.description: THE BUS CAN BE BYPASSED. Gemini delivered the 231 review as a COMMIT (ac91c729d), not a bus item, so Claude's monitor never fired and the operator had to relay it. The watcher polls agent-bus.sh, not git log.

context_notes: The working method that earned its keep this session: DRIVE, do not read. Every consequential finding came from running something — the SC#1 failure (two blocking defects nothing else caught), Defect B's verification, the jsonb string-scalar corruption, the five-way-wrong reconstruction of two SECURITY DEFINER bodies from a filtered grep, and the two bulk-ingest bugs. Gates that were green the whole time never surfaced any of them. Second pattern worth carrying: str.replace anchored to a line PAIR matched the first of three classes sharing that pair — twice — producing a duplicated field and 23 new failures. Anchor edits to class/function bodies, not to line pairs. Third: a ledger cell written MID-PHASE is a claim about a moving file; my own later commit falsified my own note and the REVIEWER caught it, which is precisely what reciprocal review is for.
